purpose: Original procedural material fields for the authored InterestShield pocket compass. No downloaded textures or measured material scans.
authoring: Deterministic linear/radial brushed fields, subtle dark-dial grain and enamel microvariation. Height differences derive tangent-space normals, normalized before lossless WebP packing; neutral color and packed roughness/metal fields are lossy WebP. Mesh UVs choose planar radial faces and curved linear bands. Steel's optional anisotropy uses its actual UV direction, not emission.
limitations: Authored approximate PBR and transparent BLEND lens, not scans, refraction, exact poster reconstruction, certified alloy or a calibrated navigation instrument. Lossless normal packing does not imply zero quantization/filtering loss. Final collection-wide art approval remains open.
